evidence.quote: Patients approved for Financial Assistance with an annual Family Income of 250% of FPL guidelines or less will receive a 100% discount on gross charges for care covered by this policy.

evidence.quote: Patients approved for Financial Assistance with an annual Family Income between 251% and 400% of FPL guidelines will receive a discount on gross charges as outlined in Appendix A.

asset_test.details: Assets (Financial Resources) are considered only for Catastrophic Balance Financial Assistance, where the account balance is compared to Family Income and Financial Resources combined. Not considered for income-based assistance.

evidence.quote: Any applicant seeking to qualify for Catastrophic Balance Financial Assistance must also supply evidence of Financial Resources as requested in the application.

residency.area: Resident of Colorado (exception possible for unscheduled emergency services at UCHealth's discretion)

evidence.quote: An individual must be a Resident of Colorado in order to qualify for Financial Assistance.

presumptive_eligibility: Presumptive eligibility (100% discount) may apply for deceased patients with no estate, homeless patients, those qualifying for public programs, or estimated household FPL of 250% or less via a predictive model.
how_to_apply: Call UCHealth Financial Counseling at 855.843.3547 (Mon-Fri 8-4 MST), visit financial counseling offices, apply in person, online or by mail; forms at https://www.uchealth.org/billing-and-pricing/financial-assistance.
